scope: Corollary 6.1 of the manuscript “A smooth three-torus diffeomorphism with simple Lebesgue spectrum” (preprints/A-smooth-three-torus-diffeomorphism-with-simple-Lebesgue-spectrum-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 144 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 0a6684b31440fc6b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 28. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For the diffeomorphism T and normalized standard volume µ of Theorem 1.1, every integer k ≥ 2 and every fixed choice of measurable sets A1, . . . , Ak ⊆ T3 satisfy µ k \ i=1 T−ti Ai ! −→ k Y i=1 µ(Ai) whenever t1 < · · · < tk are integers and min1≤i<k(ti+1 −ti) → ∞. Moreover, the Kolmogorov–Sinai entropy satisfies hµ(T) = 0, and all three Lyapunov exponents of T, counted with multiplicity, vanish at µ-almost every point.
